oracle.invariant: S1: Joomla/WordPress catalogue → {id, source: catalog, name, tokens from the map, tokensFrom tracy-web:design-tokens.json}; EmDash catalogue → tokens null; quickstart → the contract's tokens; none/unknown → record null with TEMPLATE_WEARS_NONE / DESIGN_UNRESOLVED. S2: the brief keeps template.designSystem and validates; the markdown says 'Design system: Apple (`apple`, catalog) — bound to the template. Tracy keeps it' and prints no Colours/Fonts; acceptance holds the system; the prompt's rule 1 ends with 'preserve its bound design system' on every CMS and rule 8 names that CMS's look doors as the ones not to change colours through; 'restyle it with the brief's brand colours' appears nowhere. S3: the handed-over page passes its own baseline; --ds-c-bg/--ds-c-fg redefined in custom.css fail with before/after; a colour or font rule in custom.css fails, a margin rule and a var() reference pass; a rebuilt _astro bundle with new rules passes, one with a changed token fails; a new #wp-custom-css block and an inline background-color fail.

assertionIds: a catalogue system on WordPress or Joomla: the catalogue tokens are the ruler, frozen at provision
a catalogue system on EmDash: the name is bound, the tokens are read from the site later, never the catalogue map
a quickstart look carries its own tokens, read off the release that declared it
a template that wears none, or whose look could not be resolved, writes nothing and says why
look-kept: the look Tracy handed over is held — tokens, new colour or font rules, <style> blocks and inline styles (plan wo-design-follows-template)
the template’s design system travels with the brief by name only, and the agent’s markdown says who keeps it
acceptance holds the template’s design system when the brief names one
the agent keeps the template’s design system: no restyle from brand observations, through any door (council 19/10/2026)
the look doors are named per CMS as the doors NOT to change colours through; layout CSS stays plain, the compiled CSS untouched
